dialogues.speaker: Araprabhu
dialogues.text: Festival Utsava is coming soon, but the training cannot stop. Should work even harder...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Araprabhu
dialogues.text: Hello, Nara friend.

dialogues.speaker: Araprabhu
dialogues.text: Everyone is happy to hear that you are preparing for Festival Utsava with Arama.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the training...

dialogues.speaker: Araprabhu
dialogues.text: The happier Aranara are, the less they notice the black mud and rainwater.

dialogues.speaker: Araprabhu
dialogues.text: Before Festival Utsava starts, Araprabhu must train harder to protect Vanarana.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Araprabhu
dialogues.text: Careful, don't get lost. Vana is very dangerous now.

dialogues.speaker: Araprabhu
dialogues.text: After Arama started training, Arama obtained Ararakalari none had ever seen. I must work hard too, to come close to Aradasha.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Aradasha...

dialogues.speaker: Araprabhu
dialogues.text: Araprabhu wants to be a legend like Aradasha.

dialogues.speaker: Araprabhu
dialogues.text: Standing up against the iron constructs and defending Vanarana.

dialogues.speaker: Araprabhu
dialogues.text: To become like Aradasha and be able to crush the Big Iron Chunks in the blink of an eye.

dialogues.speaker: Araprabhu
dialogues.text: Araprabhu will keep practicing Ararakalari.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the training...

dialogues.speaker: Araprabhu
dialogues.text: Araprabhu's training goal is to defeat Vanagni.

dialogues.speaker: Araprabhu
dialogues.text: The thought of the flames Vanagni spits gives Araprabhu shivers... But there must be a way...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Araprabhu
dialogues.text: Goodbye, Golden Nara. The forest will guide you.

dialogues.speaker: Araprabhu
dialogues.text: Festival Utsava is a happy day! So Araprabhu will...

dialogues.speaker: Araprabhu
dialogues.text: Practice even harder!
